headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.5.27-modder.73
summary: Client APK mod-menu libraries are now extracted even on cached installs, and the transfer dialog is now scrollable to prevent buttons from being pushed off-screen on smaller devices.

items.text: Mod-menu libraries of imported client APKs are picked up on cached installs, not only fresh imports.
Transfer content dialog is now scrollable to prevent buttons from being pushed off-screen.
